title: Reconstruction of a left matrix module from an idempotent corner
statement: Let $R$ be a unital ring, not necessarily commutative, let $d\geq1$, and put $B=M_d(R)$ [def-weil-matrix], with row-column multiplication. For $1\leq i,j\leq d$, let $E_{ij}$ have entry $1$ in position $(i,j)$ and zero elsewhere, and write $I_d$ for the identity matrix. For any unital left $B$-module $N$, put $V=E_{11}N=\{E_{11}x:x\in N\}$ and give $V$ the left $R$-action $r\cdot v=(rI_d)v$. Give $V^d$ the column action $(A\cdot(v_j))_i=\sum_j A_{ij}\cdot v_j$. The maps $$N\longrightarrow V^d,\quad x\longmapsto(E_{1i}x)_{i=1}^d,\qquad V^d\longrightarrow N,\quad(v_i)\longmapsto\sum_{i=1}^d E_{i1}v_i$$ are mutually inverse $B$-linear isomorphisms.
